g.text: This nominal run needs 8 s although the plan had 5 steps: an ADG lets an AGV enter a place only after the previous AGV's move out of it has completed, so the plan's 'following' moves become sequential. How much that costs in practice depends on how long

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Nominal run of the final ADG (every action 1 s). An action is dispatched when its count of unfinished predecessors reaches 0; AGVs report completion; that is the whole protocol.
